name: smwmusic-crash-bandicoot-koala-kong-boss-fight
title: Crash Bandicoot - Koala Kong Boss Fight
description:
The theme that plays in the boss fight against Koala Kong, a buff koala that... never really returned as a boss in the franchise, only returning as a playable character in Crash Bash and 20 years later in CTR Nitro Fueled. Fitting for cave or volcano settings.

Update (02/15): fixed the loop in the crystal sample and added missing samples
Update (03/16): added another missing sample
